items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: He was the manager? Yeah, the bass player. And might as well say I was the manager

ctx.x: But who managed to Maple Leaf? I didn't get that. Oh, Gaspar.
He was the manager? Yeah, the bass player. And might as well say I was the manager because everything they had to consult with when we went to Shreveport. That's right.
And what other places did you play? Did you play La Louisiane ever?
